name: opus-5-5-promo
description: 10.3 s promo video: 1920x1080, 30 fps, Remotion + three.js, procedurally synthesized music

scripts.render: npm run music && remotion render OpusPromo renders/opus-5-5.mp4
scripts.zerna2:assets: python3 scripts/zerna2-wood.py && python3 scripts/zerna2-paper.py && python3 scripts/zerna-tail.py --src public/zerna2/music.wav --dst public/zerna2/music-tail.wav --hit 12.10 12.60 --wet-from 12.45 --bpm 150
scripts.zerna:covers: remotion still ZernaCover1 zerna-teaser/cover.png && remotion still ZernaCover2 zerna-teaser-2/cover.png
